basis: Read-only primary current source. Source exposure is not a fresh browser usability or transport acceptance test. Main production implementation unchanged.

areas.current_owner_scope: Home/Token/Request/Affected/Receipt/Refusal plus domain operation contracts and owner reads
areas.design_join: No common complete UI facet schema; preserve owner-specific basis/guards and explanations rather than inventing frontend authority.

areas.current_owner_scope: Work specifications, containment vs prerequisites, scoped detail/graph/actions/currentness
areas.design_join: Arbitrary workflow definition editing and semantic feedback relations are not supplied by Work containment.

areas.current_owner_scope: Qualified observed activity/expiry and bounded owner-token refresh
areas.design_join: No single all-owner event stream or cross-owner replay catalogue; use actual owner cursors/tokens.

areas.current_owner_scope: Admitted packets/roles, scoped child return contracts, actual host states, independent judgement/synthesis
areas.design_join: Visual reusable topology editing and complete role configuration need definition/run contract, not new lifecycle store.

areas.current_owner_scope: Finite file-backed worker/judge/synthesis definitions and existing ledger carrier
areas.design_join: Not a universal nested visual workflow compiler; expose supported shapes and extend this owner only where defined.

areas.current_owner_scope: Read-only stage availability/gaps/guidance and exact next owner routes
areas.design_join: Stage guidance never launches or sets autonomy; do not represent a stage card as an executing role.

areas.current_owner_scope: App observed policy/provider catalogue; project/session model/provider/effort choices
areas.design_join: Global default/tier mutation and runtime selection mutation explicitly absent. Active session settings refuse; next-turn only.

areas.current_owner_scope: Immutable kernel/frame/body delivery, current instruction vs handoff/background roles and guide provenance
areas.design_join: No common global→project→workflow→step→role→object effective-setting editor; authority must remain admitted owner/tool/grant ceiling.

areas.current_owner_scope: Architecture preferences are workspace-only through narrative; shared voice profiles and project voice selection/guidance/genre use writing_style, through the profiles adapter. Both have guarded proposal/decision/application consumers.
areas.design_join: Expose the actual allowed scope and origin: architecture explicitly has no project override. General hierarchy applies only to keys/scopes their owner admits.

areas.current_owner_scope: Existing concrete start/steer/stop/continuation controls remain the constituents
areas.design_join: Scoped advance/review/human-wait policy and running-version adoption need explicit owner semantics before general toggles.

areas.current_owner_scope: Exact response target with observation/instruction distinction; source-addressed manuscript comment banking
areas.design_join: Response identity is not a paragraph anchor. Preserve each original owner identity; do not silently retarget moved text.

areas.current_owner_scope: Bound recipient identity, idempotent handoff, continuation, retry/recovery/return through Work
areas.design_join: Not a complete general multi-recipient comment router; define scoped fan-out/dedup/relevance/ack semantics before routing comments.

areas.current_owner_scope: Reuse original comment and existing Work delivery/owner relations
areas.design_join: One origin, per-recipient reason and consumed basis, stable delivery generation, bounded retry/fan-out and one aggregate return are required.

areas.current_owner_scope: Concept relations, framing/connected argument, section/paragraph reader contracts with consumed inputs
areas.design_join: Give exploration and competing hypotheses a human route; no automatic reopening of closed science campaigns.

areas.current_owner_scope: Discovery/read/bind and exact claim evidence; registered producers/results/actual runs
areas.design_join: Generic visual relation editing and cross-comment routing missing; source metadata/library presence is not claim support.

areas.current_owner_scope: Original issued basis, held/awaiting-postimage drafts, local persistence and explicit reconciliation; existing exact-source CodeMirror/fallback
areas.design_join: Extract state from rendering carefully; do not replace source identity or auto-rebase a draft after a stale read.

areas.current_owner_scope: Actual session/history/body expansion, active capability/SSE/cursor observation, draft persistence and scoped controls
areas.design_join: Long message fidelity and return context need complete interaction design; no summaries may pretend to be full historical bodies.

areas.current_owner_scope: Explicit source repositories, pinned material references, source permissions, text artifact owner and preview/download routes
areas.design_join: Reference membership grants no write permission. General binary attachment/intake/sharing needs reached owner audit, not invented upload success.

areas.current_owner_scope: Existing configured files and material reference collection are constituents
areas.design_join: Text store_artifact does not establish binary upload/intake or cross-project sharing. Define retained-original custody and scoped read capabilities before new dropzone.

areas.current_owner_scope: One node/typed-edge array drives graph plus accessible relation list; display-only folding/boundary reads
areas.design_join: Accumulated pages grow DOM; proposed editor needs bounded region/window and keyboard/list mutations through same operation contracts.

areas.area: Shell navigation, inspector and contextual help
areas.current_owner_scope: Named controllers, capture/release, context/return paths, same-origin+frame bridge, help contracts
areas.design_join: Replace ad hoc orchestration through shared lifecycle services; preserve guards/drafts, not a rewrite of all modules.

areas.current_owner_scope: Structural source map and explicit concept/guide Work-completion/meaning/validation bases
areas.design_join: Structural import cone cannot certify semantic doc currentness. General design→code→UI/agent/help claim propagation still incomplete.

areas.current_owner_scope: Existing blind_packet sealing and result banking; ordinary review role carries orientation
areas.design_join: No observed public Writing sealed action admits only declared document inputs; label as gap, not a blind review claim.

ownership_correction.qualification: Earlier present-in-source rows describe existing local owners, not a general owner/scope API or mandatory project parent. System/subsystem/contract policy, reference and workflow-definition edits need explicit owner admission; project preferences remain local and cannot authorise cross-scope effects.
